verification_method: Anonymous re-download of each successful PDF from the exact public raw Git commit, followed by independent SHA-256 and length comparison with the native capture receipt.
manifest_note: manifest.json is the immutable pre-verification capture snapshot. Its false remote_verification fields are superseded only for matching successful records by remote-verification.json; capture failures remain failures.
one_shot_workflow: Removed from the final working tree after execution; retained at capture_code_commit for reproducibility.
limitations: Eight named requests did not yield usable original PDFs.
No semantic, legal-applicability or parser qualification is claimed.
Disaster resilience document is the five-page summary, not the full strategy.
Source copyright and attribution remain with original publishers; document-specific exceptions override website defaults.
